```rust
    /// Sends an inference request with concurrency control via semaphore.
    pub async fn send_inference_request(
        &self, 
        model: &str, 
        params: ChatCompletionRequest, 
        semaphore: &tokio::sync::Semaphore
    ) -> Result<InferenceResult> {
        // Acquire a permit to ensure we don't exceed memory limits
        let _permit = semaphore.acquire().await?;

        // Create HTTP client using the configured server URL
        let client = LlamaHttpClient::new(&self.config.server_url)
            .context("Failed to create HTTP client for inference")?;

        // Send request and parse response
        let response_json = client.post("/v1/chat/completions", &params).await?;
        
        // Deserialize into InferenceResult (assuming InferenceResult is defined in super::)
        let result: InferenceResult = serde_json::from_str(&response_json)?;

        Ok(result)
    }
```
